Corollary
[Evolution of the curvature potential] Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0123 1. Corollary 5.8\group evolution-equations-on-surfaces

If $g(t)$ is a solution of the normalized Ricci flow on a surface and $f$ is the curvature potential defined by \[ \Delta f = R-r, \] then \[ \frac{\partial f}{\partial t}=\Delta f + r f - \frac12 |\nabla f|^2 + c(t) \] for a function of time $c(t)$.
